MOMONEYMATTEO.bio: MOMONEYMATTEO is a Canadian independent hip-hop artist from the north end of Halifax. His catalogue connects Halifax's contemporary rap scene with wider underground hip-hop networks, including his appearance alongside Chuuwee and Eddie Kaine on DK's 2023 track 'Gold Tooth' from Atlantic Rap Vol. 1. The collaboration places him in a cross-border East Coast context while his own artist profile identifies Halifax as his home base and origin.
